notes.title: New update brings mayhem with up to 49 AI cars
notes.content:
This brings to Steam the update we made for PS5 & Xbox Series X: You can now go into gameplay settings and change the number of rivals up to 49.

Please beware that this will be very taxing on your processor, NOT so much on your graphics card.

This means that you better have a good CPU if you want to go all the way up to 49 expecting good performance!

That's why the default number will stay at 19 for new players.

Enjoy the madness!!

tags.feature: You can now go into gameplay settings and change the number of rivals up to 49.
